objective: Improve received-message allocation where inefficient, with configurable bounded arena backing and minimum slab size.
implementation: Worker-local active and spare slabs. BytesMut slices retain a shared budget lease through Bytes::from_owner. Final slice can recover the allocation. Exhaustion and oversized records use the original allocation path.

receive_arena_bytes.meaning: Hard process backing reservation including cached and published slabs; zero disables.

receive_arena_page_bytes.meaning: Minimum slab size allocated lazily per active worker, shared across connections.

validation.network: 13 WebTransport tests plus forced-transmit, read-budget and config-secret integration suites passed.
validation.docs: docs/operations.md describes knobs, limits, caching and metrics

limits: Loopback fixed-client comparisons; three12s rotations. Small throughput differences are not confidence intervals.
Allocator diagnostics are separate from ordinary throughput/RSS and include monitoring/background work.
Preallocation is lazy and per worker, not per connection or an eager process startup reservation.
Arena backing cap excludes allocator metadata and is not an RSS limit; existing staging and output budgets remain independent.
This changes reliable application record bodies, not QUIC UDP ingress storage, receive-assembler metadata or legacy WebSocket decoder storage.
No full native-suite, browser, injected-loss or deployment acceptance is claimed; broader transport parity remains unmet.

requirements_audit.profile_existing_path: Per-record Vec allocation confirmed in RecordReader and earlier allocation stacks.
requirements_audit.configure_and_bound: CLI/env fields validated; separate arena backing quota includes held output slices and worker caches.
requirements_audit.reuse_without_corruption: Retained views, final-slice return, cancellation, fragmentation and exact wire payload/FIFO checks pass.
requirements_audit.fallback: Unit and real UDP/TLS/H3 mixed-size tests cover exhaustion and oversized records without rejecting admissible traffic.
requirements_audit.measure_actual_result: Frozen source/images,27 ordinary runs,8 size-shape runs,3 ordinary100k captures,2 separate heap diagnostics and6 paced captures.
requirements_audit.usable_integration: Tested uninstrumented image installed in target/release/war-relay; source375 inputs and both CLI flags verified. Arena default remains disabled.

type_layout.scope: Separate root-library -Zprint-type-sizes diagnostic; ordinary timing uses the frozen uninstrumented image.

local_installation.selection: Install tested configurable implementation locally; arena remains opt-in. Broader transport pivot is not accepted.

decision: Keep a configurable opt-in arena for demonstrably lower allocation churn and private CPU; do not claim general throughput/RSS improvement or enable it automatically.
